conditions: Obligations scale with High/Critical capability thresholds in Tracked Categories
objective: OpenAI's framework for tracking and preparing for frontier AI capabilities that could create new risks of severe harm, by evaluating models against capability thresholds and requiring safeguards that sufficiently minimize risk before deployment or further development.

related_policies.policy: OpenAI Frontier Governance Framework (reported May 2026; unverified)

conflict_rule: Self-imposed policy; statutory obligations (e.g., CA SB 53, EU AI Act GPAI obligations) apply independently.

Secondary sources report (a) a 'Frontier Governance Framework' published ~28 May 2026 as a regulatory-facing document built on the Preparedness Framework, and (b) disbanding of the Preparedness team around end of July 2026; both unverified and recorded only in key_dates/notes. binding=false: voluntary framework binding on OpenAI itself only, though statutes such as CA SB 53 may require publishing and following a frontier AI framework.

clauses.section: Tracked Categories (Biological and Chemical; Cybersecurity; AI Self-improvement)
clauses.original_text: OpenAI tracks three frontier capability categories it treats as plausible, measurable, severe, net-new and instantaneous-or-irremediable risks: Biological and Chemical, Cybersecurity, and AI Self-improvement, each with High and Critical capability thresholds; further areas (e.g., long-range autonomy, sandbagging, autonomous replication and adaptation, undermining safeguards, nuclear and radiological) are Research Categories.
clauses.object: frontier model capabilities in Tracked Categories
clauses.requirement: evaluate covered models against High and Critical thresholds in each Tracked Category
clauses.interpretation_notes: Paraphrase: the official PDF (cdn.openai.com) could not be fetched from the compilation environment, so wording is from knowledge of v2 and is not verbatim; section headings are descriptive, not verified section numbers.

clauses.original_text: Models that reach High capability in a Tracked Category must have safeguards that sufficiently minimize the associated risk of severe harm before they are deployed.
clauses.requirement: do not deploy a High-capability model until safeguards sufficiently minimize the associated severe-harm risk
clauses.condition: model reaches the High threshold in a Tracked Category
clauses.applicable_systems: OpenAI frontier models at High capability
clauses.interpretation_notes: Paraphrase: the official PDF (cdn.openai.com) could not be fetched from the compilation environment, so wording is from knowledge of v2 and is not verbatim; section headings are descriptive, not verified section numbers.

clauses.original_text: Models that reach Critical capability also require safeguards that sufficiently minimize the associated risks during development, not only at deployment.
clauses.requirement: implement safeguards sufficiently minimizing risk during further development of Critical-capability models
clauses.condition: model reaches the Critical threshold in a Tracked Category
clauses.purpose: prevent severe harm including from internal development
clauses.applicable_systems: OpenAI frontier models at Critical capability
clauses.interpretation_notes: Paraphrase: the official PDF (cdn.openai.com) could not be fetched from the compilation environment, so wording is from knowledge of v2 and is not verbatim; section headings are descriptive, not verified section numbers.

clauses.section: Governance: Safety Advisory Group, Leadership and Board Safety and Security Committee
clauses.original_text: The Safety Advisory Group reviews Capabilities Reports and Safeguards Reports and makes recommendations on whether safeguards sufficiently minimize risk; OpenAI Leadership makes the decision, and the Safety and Security Committee of the Board oversees these decisions.
clauses.actor: OpenAI Safety Advisory Group; OpenAI Leadership
clauses.requirement: route deployment/development decisions for covered models through SAG review, leadership decision and board-committee oversight
clauses.interpretation_notes: Paraphrase: the official PDF (cdn.openai.com) could not be fetched from the compilation environment, so wording is from knowledge of v2 and is not verbatim; section headings are descriptive, not verified section numbers. Governance bodies corroborated by secondary sources.

clauses.section: Adjustments in response to other frontier developers
clauses.original_text: If another frontier AI developer releases a high-risk system without comparable safeguards, OpenAI may adjust its requirements, but only after rigorously confirming the changed risk landscape, publicly acknowledging the adjustment, assessing that it does not meaningfully increase overall risk of severe harm, and keeping safeguards at a level more protective.
clauses.requirement: may relax requirements only under stated conditions including public acknowledgement
clauses.condition: another developer releases a high-risk system without comparable safeguards; risk landscape rigorously confirmed
clauses.purpose: competitive flexibility bounded by risk conditions
